name: Donkey Kong Jr.™
description:
Donkey Kong has finally been
captured by Mario! In this unique
role-reversal platformer, you play as
DK's son, Junior, and must save dad
from Mario's clutches.

Swing and climb your way across
vines and chains to grab the keys that
unlock Donkey Kong's cage, avoiding
nasty critters like Snapjaws and
Nitpickers.

It's a game all about speed and high
scores - so get swinging and rack up
those points - but don't forget to
rescue DK!
disclaimer:

여기에는 고객님의 건강와 안전을 위한 중요한 내용이 기재되어 있습니다. 
또한 본체의 사용설명서도 함께 읽어 주십시오.
